items.title: Scott Bessent's growth plans aren't enough to tame surging deficit and debt pile, IMF chief says
items.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said Bessent’s reliance on growth won’t cut the U.S. deficit and $40 trillion debt fast enough, calling for fiscal consolidation.

items.title: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 as profit smashes expectations
items.description: ASML said some customers are "expressing an interest" in placing orders with the company in 2029 and 2030, giving investors a view into longer-term demand.

items.title: Diesel squeeze set to last well into 2027 as Iran war disrupts supply, IEA says
items.description: Diesel supply is expected to remain tight into 2027 as Iran war-related disruption, falling inventories and resilient demand strain the market, the IEA said.

items.title: U.S. Treasury yields inch lower as investors await key inflation report
items.description: U.S. Treasury yields inched lower on Wednesday as investors awaited the latest CPI inflation reading ahead of a flurry of economic data this week.

items.title: Russia pounds Ukraine's energy infrastructure, leaving 600,000 without power
items.description: A ballistic missile has struck energy infrastructure supposedly covered by the "energy ceasefire" announced by Trump on Sunday, Zelenskyy said.

items.title: Judge extends block on Trump White House ban of MS NOW, CNN and Politico
items.description: President Donald Trump had sought to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN and Politico from reporting from the White House.

items.title: Crypto bosses, CEOs and F1: Singapore's business events boom gathers pace
items.description: Singapore's Formula 1 race week is a major business draw as a growing number of conferences coincide with the Grand Prix.

items.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
items.description: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

items.title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
items.description: The country's customs agency released September trade data on Wednesday.

items.title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since June 2022, beating expectations
items.description: The increase was higher than the 4.5% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and higher than the 3.8% seen in the previous month.

items.title: Taiwan agrees to buy 30% of gas from Alaska LNG project, Trump says
items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that Taiwan had agreed to buy 30% of the gas from a pipeline project in Alaska.

items.title: South Korean carmaker Hyundai plans 'strategic' investment of $15.5 billion in India by 2032
items.description: Korean car company Hyundai says India is a strategic core market

items.title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, D.C. to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
items.description: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.

items.title: Singapore third-quarter GDP growth softens from four-year high but beats estimates
items.description: The GDP print beat expectations of a 5% growth from economists polled by Reuters.

items.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI employee who allegedly planted recording device in conference room
items.description: The Tuesday incident comes as the ChatGPT-maker, along with competitors, faces heightened scrutiny over its safety practices.

items.title: Goldman says investors are looking for 'profitable' Chinese business growth overseas
items.description: Sluggish consumer demand in China has pushed many companies, such as electric car brands, to accelerate plans for entering other countries.

items.title: Here's where Jim Cramer stands on this newly public AI infrastructure stock
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors should hold off on buying newly public AI infrastructure company Accelevation Holdings.

items.title: Six Flags shares decline following deadly roller coaster incident
items.description: One person died and several others were injured in an incident involving the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia, according to reports.

items.title: Judge says Musk engaged in intimidation of ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans, clears her name
items.description: Ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans' name was cleared by a federal judge after Elon Musk and other government officials falsely accused her of criminal actions in 2025.

items.title: Don't let inflation bite — how to hedge with TIPS, commodities and infrastructure funds
items.description: TIPS are looking attractive but they aren't the only way to get inflation protection.
